description: Recreation of the interactive 'Global Temperature Record' line chart from temperaturerecord.org (powered by the 2 Degrees Institute / climatelevels.org). Shows global surface temperature anomaly (base period 1951-1980) from the year 1000 to present, combining paleoclimatic reconstructions (annual resolution, to 1879) with modern NASA GISS instrumental records (monthly resolution, 1880-present). Scroll to zoom and drag to pan, similar to the site's click-and-drag zoom.
